checks: English, context and target SHA-256 recomputed from the bytes on disk at the HEAD named in scope.

ICU parity: all 81 messages (and the 700 messages of all four namespaces x 7 locales) parsed with the project's @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser; argument names/types equal English's; key sets and order equal; NFC; no bidi control characters; no stray whitespace. fr: U+202F before ; : ? ! and inside « » confirmed.

Back-translations of every changed key recorded; each is faithful to English (hi phase_unheard 'The voice page is not connected' / connecting_caption 'The voice page is opening' now carry their state and differ from each other).
Terms re-checked against existing UI: hi डिक्टेशन, स्वीकृति दें; ur ڈकटیشن (composer term, ×4 in ui.chat.composer); fr sur l'écran. Style guide and glossary read as binding (hashes in references).
